definition.summary: Eligible ICU stay

definition.summary: Death before discharge
definition.temporal_rule: Outcome is attached to the eligible hospital admission.
definition.value_rule: hospital_expire_flag = 1.
definition.missingness_rule: Missing admission outcome blocks analysis.

definition.summary: Death from any cause, in or out of hospital
definition.temporal_rule: Date of death relative to time zero; out-of-hospital deaths are captured from state records up to one year after the last discharge.
definition.value_rule: A recorded patients.dod within the outcome window.
definition.missingness_rule: No recorded date of death within one year of the last discharge is treated as alive; follow-up beyond one year is censored.

definition.summary: Age at index admission
definition.temporal_rule: Calculate at the prespecified index time using the MIMIC de-identification policy.
definition.value_rule: Use anchor_age and anchor_year with admission time.
definition.missingness_rule: Missing age is reported and not interpreted as zero.

definition.summary: Source-recorded administrative sex
definition.temporal_rule: Patient-level attribute.
definition.value_rule: Preserve source categories and report them.
definition.missingness_rule: Missing values remain explicit.

definition.summary: Charlson comorbidity index from the index admission's ICD diagnosis codes (Quan 2005 ICD-9-CM/ICD-10 algorithms, original Charlson weights, hierarchical groups).
definition.temporal_rule: Diagnosis codes of the index admission (assigned at discharge).
definition.value_rule: Sum of weights of groups with at least one matching code; a superseding group replaces the one it supersedes.
definition.missingness_rule: An admission without qualifying codes scores 0.

definition.summary: Systolic blood pressure (ICU charted)
definition.temporal_rule: ICU charted measurements relative to time zero; ICU patients only.

definition.missingness_rule: Patients without a charted value in the window have no measurement; they are not assumed normal.
